title: Polynomial Classification Game
description: Interactive classification challenge testing student ability to classify algebraic expressions as monomials, binomials, or trinomials.
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Algebra I
Polynomial Expressions
Polynomial Classification
learningObjectives: Understand the key concepts of polynomial classification game
Explore polynomial classification game through interactive visualization
Apply knowledge of polynomial classification game to solve problems
Test understanding of polynomial classification game through interactive exercises

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Interactive visual modeling with step-by-step exploration and immediate feedback
keyQuestions: What mathematical relationship is illustrated by this model?
How does changing one variable or parameter influence the outcome?
commonMisconceptions: Confusing visual scale or orientation with underlying numeric operations
assessmentOpportunities: Explain the displayed relationship in student's own words
Solve an algebraic problem and confirm result with the interactive model

learningObjectives: Classify algebraic expressions by number of terms (monomial, binomial, trinomial) and polynomial degree.
prerequisites: Introductory familiarity with variables and algebraic expressions
